description: This file declares exported API functions related to the TLS Env Controller component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It serves as an interface header for TLS environment control within the broader project.

methods.name: TlsCreateEnvController
methods.description: Creates and initializes the TLS Environment Controller object with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: TlsEcoCreate
methods.description: Constructs the TLS Eco object with specified context and handles.

methods.name: TlsEcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the TLS Eco object and releases associated resources.

methods.name: TlsEcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the TLS Eco object during setup.

methods.name: TlsEcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Eco object with default or specified parameters.
